blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in deep learning and the public availability of computed tomography (CT) datasets with paired reports have enabled many Text-to-CT generators. However, their evaluations almost always differ in preprocessing and metrics, which hinders comparison. Moreover, their protocols almost never test how editing the report changes the CT, not even at the same seed, so the report is often assumed to control the anatomy without evidence of how much and how consistently it does. We therefore propose CtrlCT, a toolkit that tests two properties of a generator, Credibility and Control. Credibility tests compare generated CTs, as a population, with real CTs and reports; Control tests are metamorphic and need no reference CT: at a fixed seed, editing one finding should change it as requested, keep negated findings absent and shift distant anatomy no more than a new seed, and the change should hold across seeds. A Report Card summarises all measures and insights for each generator. We benchmark five public generators on 940 chest CTs and 687 edits of pleural effusion and cardiomegaly, holding out a sixth to test the toolkit. Among them, the most credible generators barely respond to an added effusion, while the most responsive produce less realistic and less diverse CTs. The analyses proposed in the literature do not reveal this. We release CtrlCT, its edits, seeds and 30,525 synthetic CTs after acceptance.
blocks.zh: 最近,在深入学习和公开提供配对报告的计算成像数据集方面取得的进展,使许多文本到文本生成器成为可能。 然而,它们的评价在预处理和计量方面几乎总是有差异,这妨碍了比较。 此外,他们的协议几乎从未测试编辑报告是如何改变CT的,甚至不是在同一种子上,因此报告常常被假定控制解剖学,而没有证据证明它有多么多和一贯. 因此,我们提出CtrlCT,一个测试发电机的两个特性的工具包,即可靠性和控制。 可信度测试将生成的CT作为人口,与真实的CT和报告进行比较; 控制测试是变形的,不需要参考CT:在固定种子中,编辑一个发现应当按照要求更改,保留否定的发现缺失并转移远方的解剖学不超过一个新的种子,变化应当贯穿种子. 报告卡概述了每个生成器的所有措施和见解。 我们以940个胸口CT和687编辑胸膜取精和心肌增生的5台公共发电机作为基准,持有第6个测试工具包. 其中,最可靠的发电机几乎无法对添加的去液化反应,而反应最迅速的发电机产生的CT更不现实,也更不多样化. 文献中建议的分析并未揭示这一点。 我们释放出CtrlCT,它的编辑,种子和30,525个被接受后的合成CT.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Text-to-CT generators synthesise 3D computed tomography (CT) volumes from radiology reports.
Advances in deep learning have led to a growing number of such generators [ 32 , 13 , 33 , 5 ] , most trained on CT-RATE [ 17 ] , the reference public dataset of chest CTs paired with reports, released in 2024. Text-to-CT generation now also features in major medical imaging challenges, such as VLM3D [ 18 ] , built on CT-RATE.

文本到CT生成器合成e 3D 计算成像(CT)卷,来自放射学报告.
深度学习的进步导致此类发电机数量不断增加[32,13,33,5],培训最多的是CT-RATE[17],胸形CT的参考公共数据集与报告对齐,2024年发布. 现在的文本到CT生成在主要的医学成像挑战中也有特色,如基于CT-RATE的VLM3D[18].

blocks.en: Besides real reports, these generators can also be conditioned on modified versions of them, adapted to emulate the style and content of clinicians’ reports and possibly describing rare cases. This is especially useful for rare combinations of findings, whether to augment real datasets without new annotated scans [ 26 ] or in clinical and simulation settings. A change in the report should produce the corresponding change in the generated CT, at every seed. Whether the report is real or edited, errors and misalignments between it and the CT can have a heavy impact, deciding whether these generators can be used in real cases.
blocks.zh: 除了真实的报告外,这些发电机还可以以修改过的版本为条件,以模仿临床医生报告的风格和内容,并可能描述罕见的病例。 这对罕见的发现组合特别有用,无论是在没有新的注解扫描的情况下增加真实数据集[26],还是在临床和模拟环境下. 对报告的修改应产生每一种子生成的CT的相应变化。 报告是真实的还是编辑的,它和CT之间的错误和错配可能会产生很大影响,决定这些发电机是否可用于真实的情况.

blocks.en:
Surprisingly, this correspondence is not systematically tested when new generators are released ( Tab. 1 ). Evaluations usually score sets of CTs from
unedited reports, by distance from real CTs ( e.g . , Fréchet distance [ 20 ] ) and agreement with the reports
( e.g . , AUROC), not whether a CT changes when its report does.
blocks.zh:
令人惊讶的是,当新发电机被放出时,这种函文没有经过系统的测试(Tab. 1 ). 评价通常从
未经编辑的报告,按与真正的CT的距离(如Fréchet距离[20])和同意报告分列
(例如,AUROC),而不是CT是否在报告时发生变化。

blocks.en: Measuring the anatomical control of Text-to-CT generators, that is, quantifying and comparing their ability to modify a CT in a targeted way when its report changes, without altering its other regions, is currently an open challenge and a largely unexplored problem. The main difficulty is that an edited report describes a patient who was never scanned, so no reference CT exists. Without such tests, good scores can lead to an unjustified illusion of control over the generative process ( Sec. 5.1 ). Beyond all this, a fair framework for comparing generators is missing, since each paper chooses its own baselines, preprocessing, features and scorers (App. A).
blocks.zh: 衡量对Text至CT生成器的解剖控制,即当CT报告发生变化而不改变其他区域时,量化和比较其以目标方式修改CT的能力,目前是一项公开的挑战,而且在很大程度上是一个尚未探讨的问题。 主要困难是,经编辑的报告描述了一个从未被扫描过的病人,因此不存在参考CT. 没有这种测试,好的分数就会导致对基因过程的不合理控制幻觉(第5.1条)。 除此之外,缺少一个比较发电机的公平框架,因为每份文件都选择自己的基线、预处理、特征和计分器(App.A)。

blocks.en: We therefore build CtrlCT, a behavioural testing toolkit for Text-to-CT generators ( Figs. 1 and 4 ), with two families of tests under one protocol. Pre-Flight Checks first harmonise the generated volumes: they align orientation and voxel spacing with real CTs and flag intensity offsets, missing CTs and edits beyond the text window (App. D). Then, the Credibility tests measure, on the CTs of unedited reports, how realistic and diverse they are against real CTs, how well a findings classifier recovers their reports, how much they move when the report is perturbed, and how useful they are to train classifiers tested on real CTs. Next, the Control tests evaluate whether edits control the anatomy: they compare the CTs generated at a fixed seed from a report and from its edit, isolating the effect of the edit, and check three relations: the edited finding changes as requested ( Target Response , C1); findings that the report negates stay absent and distant anatomy shifts no more than under a new seed ( Containment , C2); and the response holds across seeds ( Reliability , C3). Finally, a Report Card summarises all measures and insights. The approach is designed to be reapplied to new generators.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们建造了CtrlCT(图1和图4)行为测试工具箱,在一个协议下进行两套测试。 Flight前检查首先协调生成的音量:它们将方向和voxel间距与真实的CT和旗帜强度相抵消,缺失的CT和文本窗口以外的编辑(App. D). 然后,信誉测试在未经编辑的报告的CT上衡量,这些测试与真实的CT相比,是怎样现实和多样的,一个结果分类者恢复了他们的报告,报告被扰动时他们移动了多少,以及他们培训在真实的CT上测试的分类者有多大用处. 其次,控制测试评价编辑是否控制了解剖学:它们比较了报告及其编辑中固定种子生成的CT,隔离了编辑的效果,并检查了三种关系:按要求编辑的查找变化(目标反应,C1);发现报告否定了缺席和远解剖学转移,不过在新种子(包含,C2)下;以及反应在种子之间占据(可靠性,C3). 最后,报告卡概述了所有措施和见解。 这种方法旨在重新适用于新的发电机。

blocks.en: We benchmark five public generators on chest CTs of CT-RATE, with edits that add or remove a pleural effusion (fluid around the lungs) or cardiomegaly (an enlarged heart), and use a sixth, CTFlow [ 45 ] , held out to test the toolkit. Our results show that credible CTs can mask poor Control: the two most credible generators barely respond to an added effusion, despite using the report as a whole.
blocks.zh: 我们以CT-RATE的胸腔CT为基准计算5台公共发电机,其编辑器可添加或去除胸膜充血(在肺周围流淌)或心肌充血(心脏扩张),并使用第6台CTFlow [45],用于测试工具包。 我们的结果表明,可信的CT可以掩盖控制不善:尽管整个报告都使用,但最可靠的两台发电机几乎无法对增加的输液作出反应。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A reference-free formalisation of anatomical control through three metamorphic criteria, distinguishing targeted responses, unintended anatomical shifts and consistency across seeds. • Evidence that credible CTs can conceal failures of finding-specific control: Realism and agreement with the whole report can be high when edits fail, as comparisons with conventional metrics on the same CTs show. • CtrlCT, a reusable toolkit for evaluating and diagnosing Text-to-CT generators under a common protocol, demonstrated on five public models and independently applied to a sixth.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:通过三个变体标准,将解剖控制的无参考正式化,区分有针对性的反应、意想不到的解剖变化和不同种子的一致性。 • 支助 有证据表明,可信的CT可以掩盖发现特定控制失败: 现实主义和对整个报告的同意度在编辑失败时可能很高,因为与同一CT上的传统度量衡的比较表明. • CtrlCT是一套可重复使用的工具包,用于根据共同协议评价和诊断文本至CT发电机,在五个公共模型上演示,并独立适用于第六个。

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 有关工作

blocks.en: Text-to-CT generators. Text-to-CT generators differ in how they use report information for conditioning [ 39 , 38 ] : GenerateCT predicts CT tokens and then applies diffusion super-resolution [ 15 ] ; CTFlow generates slice blocks by flow matching [ 45 ] ; Text2CT aligns reports and volumes contrastively [ 32 ] ; MedSyn and RAGText2CT add generated or retrieved anatomy [ 48 , 33 ] ; MedSyn2 (MedSynV2) uses gated attention and optional masks [ 5 ] . Other generators, not evaluated here, lack public weights [ 2 , 16 , 13 ] or are conditioned on masks with or without text [ 14 ] (we use MedSyn2 with text only; App. A). Among the papers of Tab. 1 , two consider a change of report, without a systematic comparison at the same seed: MedSyn compares groups of CTs generated from a description and from its negation, on its own model [ 48 ] , and MedSyn2 shows qualitative edits of report and masks, one at a fixed seed [ 5 ] . None compares the response to report edits across generators.
blocks.zh: 文本对CT生成器. 文本对CT生成器在使用报告信息进行调制[39,38]方面有所不同: 生成CT 预测 CT 符号,然后应用扩散超分辨率 [15]; CT Flow通过匹配 [45] 的流量生成切片块; Text2CT 将报告和量对比 [32] ; MedSyn 和 RAGText2CT 添加生成或检索的解剖学 [48, 33]; MedSyn2(MedSynV2) 使用有门的注意和可选的口罩 [5]. 其他发电机,在这里没有评价,缺乏公共重量[2,16,13],或者以带有或没有文本的口罩为条件[14](我们只使用带有文本的MedSyn2;App.A). 在Tab. 1的论文中,有两篇考虑修改报告,而没有在同一种子上进行系统比较: MedSyn以自己的模式比较了从描述及其否定中生成的CT组,MedSyn2显示了报告和面具的质量编辑,一个在固定种子[5]. 无一比对报告各个生成器编辑的响应.

blocks.en: Benchmarks and evaluation protocols. Benchmarks for synthetic chest radiographs [ 6 ] and for natural images and video [ 22 , 29 , 37 ] measure several properties under one fixed protocol, since scores depend on preprocessing and feature extraction [ 40 , 23 , 47 ] , and release prompts and procedure instead of target outputs [ 22 ] . CtrlCT adapts this design to report-conditioned 3D CT, with report edits, report perturbations and multiple seeds.
blocks.zh: 基准和评价协议。 合成胸腔放射图的基准[6]和自然图像和视频的基准[22、29、37]根据一个固定协议衡量若干属性,因为分数取决于预处理和特征提取[40、23、47],并释放提示和程序而不是目标产出[22]。 CtrlCT修改了这个设计以报告有条件的3D CT,报告编辑,报告扰动和多种种子.

blocks.en: Controlled editing and behavioural testing. Image editing benchmarks score whether the requested change appears and whether the rest of the input image is preserved, often within a mask [ 25 , 24 ] . Prompt-to-Prompt edits generated images by changing the prompt and reusing cross-attention maps to preserve their layout [ 19 ] . Medical editing benchmarks [ 28 ] and counterfactual studies [ 12 , 31 , 34 , 49 ] examine whether requested changes occur and what else changes. CtrlCT evaluates these behaviours in report-conditioned CT synthesis: it compares CTs generated from original and edited radiology reports at the same seed, checking whether the requested change occurs without unintended anatomical shifts, consistently across multiple seeds. Metamorphic testing formalises these checks as relations between inputs and outputs [ 3 , 43 ] , and CheckList [ 41 ] adapted it to NLP models with directional tests, where an input change must move the output in a known direction, and invariance tests, where it must not; similar tests expose vision-language models that ignore how words are composed [ 44 , 50 ] . In CtrlCT, adding a finding is a directional test and rewording a report an invariance test (App. C).
blocks.zh: 控制编辑和行为测试. 图像编辑基准评分要求的更改是否出现,其他输入图像是否保存,通常在面具内[25,24]. 即时到即时编辑通过更改即时和重用交叉注意地图来保存其布局[19] 生成图像. 医学编辑基准[28]和反事实研究[12,31,34,49]审查是否发生了要求的修改,还有什么变化. 代码 CT在报告附带条件的CT综合中评价这些行为:它比较了同一种子的原始和编辑的放射报告中产生的CT,检查所要求的变化是否在没有意外解剖转移的情况下发生,始终跨越多个种子. Metatorphic测试将这些检查形式化为输入与输出的关系[3,43],CheckList [41]将其适应了方向测试的NLP模型,其中输入变化必须使输出向已知方向移动,而偏移测试则不能;类似的测试暴露了忽略词组构成的视觉语言模型[44,50]. 在CtrlCT中,添加一个发现是方向性测试,并重写一个报告不变化测试(App. C).

blocks.zh: CTLCT 测试

CtrlCT evaluates two properties of a Text-to-CT generator ( Fig. 2 ). Credibility : as a population, the CTs generated from
real reports match the distribution of real CTs, agree with and depend on their reports, and are useful for training. Control : at a fixed seed, editing one finding changes it as requested and leaves the rest of the report
satisfied.

All generators receive the same real reports and seeds. Within each generator, we vary one input at a time: a statement, the whole report or the seed. Differences between the resulting CTs characterise the generator’s response, without identifying the contributions of individual components of its pipeline.
Each measure is compared with up to two reference values: its value when the tested property is absent by design ( null control ), and its value on real CTs or for an ideal generator.

blocks.en: Realism compares synthetic and real CTs as two populations, with the Fréchet distance (FD) [ 20 ] on image features ( Sec. 4.3 ). The FD is low between two volume-disjoint subsets of real data (real reference) and high when one of them is blurred with a Gaussian filter ( σ = 4 \sigma=4 mm), which makes the same CTs unrealistic (null control). The FD, however, also depends on Diversity , how much of the real distribution the synthetic one covers. A generator can produce realistic CTs and still miss the rarer anatomies and details of the real data, the patterns that matter most when synthetic CTs are used in training sets. We separate the two on 3D features: precision [ 27 ] , the share of synthetic CTs within the neighbourhood of a real CT, measures Realism; recall [ 27 ] and coverage [ 36 ] , the share of real CTs with a synthetic neighbour, measure Diversity. As for the FD, the reference of all three is their value between two disjoint subsets of real CTs; Diversity has no null control.
blocks.zh: 现实主义将合成和真实的CT比作两个群体,在图像特征上与Fréchet距离(FD)[20](sec.4.3. FD在真实数据的两个卷断子集(real reference)之间是低的,当其中之一与高斯滤波器模糊时是高的(x=4\sigma=4mm),这使得相同的CT不现实(null control). 然而,FD也取决于多样性,即合成的FD所覆盖的实际分布范围。 生成器可以产生现实的CT,并且仍然想念稀有的解剖学和真实数据的细节,即当合成的CT用于训练集时最重要的规律. 我们在3D特征上将两者分开:精度[27],合成CT在真实CT周边的比重,度量现实主义;回顾[27]和覆盖[36],真实CT与合成邻的比重,度量多样性. 至于FD,所有三个词的参考值都是在真实CT的两个脱节子集之间的价值;多样性没有完全的控制.

blocks.en: Report Agreement checks that each generated CT shows the findings of its own report. Most published evaluations use a CLIP score or a findings classifier (App. A); we compute the AUROC of a findings classifier against the report’s labels for the 18 findings. Its null control is chance (0.5), and its reference is its value on real CTs. We then recompute AUROC after pairing each CT with the labels of another case’s report ( Swap ): the drop relative to the original AUROC quantifies how much better CTs agree with their own reports than with those of other cases. The drop is 0 when a CT agrees with any report as well as with its own (null control), and its reference is the drop on real CTs.
blocks.zh: 《报告协议》检查每个生成的CT显示自己报告的结论。 大多数公布的评价都使用CLIP分数或结果分类器(App.A);我们根据18项结果的报告标签计算结果分类器的AUROC。 它的无效控制是偶然的(0.5),它的参考值是它在真正的CT上的价值. 然后,我们将AUROC重新计算,然后将每个CT与另一个案例报告的标签(交换)配对:相对于原AUROC的下降量,将CT与自己的报告的一致程度比其他案例的更好。 当一个CT同意任何报告以及它自己的(null control)时,下降为0,它的参考是真实CT的下降.

blocks.en: Utility aims to measure how useful the generated data are for downstream tasks, and is computed following the train-on-synthetic, test-on-real (TSTR) paradigm [ 6 ] : for each finding, a binary logistic classifier is trained on the same 3D features of the generated CTs, labelled by the presence or absence of the finding in their reports, and tested on a held-out set of real CTs. The metric is the AUROC, and the null control corresponds to random guessing. The same classifier trained on features of real CTs is the reference.
blocks.zh: 实用性旨在衡量生成的数据对下游任务有多大用处,并按列车合成、测试和实际(TSTER)范式计算:对于每个发现,一个二进制物流分类器都接受关于生成的CT的相同3D特性的培训,其标签是其报告中是否有发现,并且测试的是一组被搁置的真正CT。 度量衡是AUROC,无效控制对应随机猜测. 对真实的CT特征进行训练的同一分类器是参考.

C2 Containment. We measure whether an edit changes the generated CT only where requested ( Fig. 3 c). We test two requirements: negated findings must stay absent, and anatomy far from the edited finding must not shift more than it varies between CTs of the unedited report generated with different seeds. Negated Findings tests the first requirement. For each finding negated in the report, a classifier checks its presence in the CT of the report and in that of its edit, both generated with the same seed. The measure is how much their presence rises after the edit, on average ( Eq. 2 ). We remove the part of this rise due to the classifier, which tends to detect the findings that usually accompany an effusion ( Sec. 4.3 ). Its ideal value is 0, i.e . no negated finding appears; it has no null control. We do not count findings that the report does not mention: in real patients they can appear together with f f , so they may legitimately change with it ( Sec. 6 ). Distant Anatomy tests the second: an effusion legitimately displaces the adjacent tissue, so we read the anatomy beyond
50 mm from it (App. A), where the edit requests no change.

blocks.en:
CT-RATE [ 17 ] pairs non-contrast chest CTs with reports and 18 abnormality labels extracted from them. From
the validation reconstructions listed by the Text2CT release [ 32 ] , we keep one per scan: 940 CTs of 782
patients, none of whom appears in the training split.
We edit two findings and fix all edited texts before generating any CT. For pleural effusion we use the 567 reports (479 patients) whose statement on effusion can be replaced without touching another finding: 396 negate it, and the edit adds it; 171 state it, and the edit removes it. For heart size we use 120 reports, one per
patient: 50 enlargements and 70 normalisations. An addition requests a combination of findings that is rare in the CT-RATE training split (24,128 scans). For the 396 effusion additions, the median number of training scans with the same 18 labels falls from 10.5 for the original report to 1 for the edited one, and no training scan matches the edited report in 41% of them (62% of heart enlargements). Rare is not unrealistic: 30% of the 940 unedited reports also match no training scan. Figure 1 shows one addition; App. A provides further details.

blocks.en: The CtrlCT toolkit is implemented in five steps ( Fig. 4 ). (1) During the first step, the Prompt Suite is produced, i.e . the set of reports and seeds to be given as input to the generative process. (2) The generator uses this information to produce the synthetic volumes. (3) The Pre-Flight Checks align the orientation of these volumes and flag what would invalidate the measures. (4) The CtrlCT Tests compute each measure with its 95% bootstrap interval over patients. (5) The Report Card ( Fig. 5 ) is the output of the toolkit: it places each measure between its null control and its real or ideal value, and lists the diagnostic rules that are triggered. The twelve rules are calibrated on the five benchmarked generators and applied to the held-out CTFlow as a user would to a new generator. App. D gives the details and the cards of all the 5+1 generators.
blocks.zh: CtrlCT工具包分五个步骤(图4)实施. (1) 第一步,制作 " 即时套件 " ,即提供一套报告和种子,作为对基因过程的投入。 (2)生成器利用这种信息生成合成卷。 (3) Flight前检查使这些卷的取向一致,并标出哪些会使措施失效。 (4) CtrlCT测试以95%的靴子间隔对病人进行计算。 (5)"报告卡"(图5)是工具包的输出:它将每个度量衡置于其无效控制与其真实或理想价值之间,并列出触发的诊断规则. 这12条规则在五个基准发电机上进行校准,并适用于被搁置的CTFlow,因为用户会将它适用于一个新的发电机。 应用。 D给出所有5+1发电机的细节和卡片.

blocks.en: The Prompt Suite has two versions: Full, with 6,017 CTs per generator (the 940 cases, 567 effusion edits and 120 heart edits), used for the benchmark, and Lite, with 1,814 (200 cases, 100 effusion edits and the same 120 heart edits), for cheaper tests of new generators. Lite is a random subset of the cases and effusion edits: over 50 draws of it, the rankings of the five generators agree with those of Full on the measures compared (mean Kendall’s τ \tau 0.78–1.00; App. D).
blocks.zh: Full Suite套件有两个版本:Full,每台发电机有6,017 CT(940个案例,567个充电编辑和120个心脏编辑),用于基准;Lite,1,814个案例(200个案例,100个充电编辑和相同的120个心脏编辑),用于对新发电机进行更便宜的测试. Lite是案例和充电编辑的随机子集:其中超过50幅画,五台发电机的排名与Full的排名一致,对比较的测量(Mean Kendall的\tau 0.78–1.00;App. D).

blocks.en: Results
blocks.zh: 结果

blocks.en: No generator reaches real CTs on Credibility. Table 2 shows the overall performance of the five benchmarked generators. In its Credibility rows, the FD is 15 to 40 times its value on real CTs, coverage is at most 0.44 (0.94 on real CTs), Report Agreement drops by only 0.04–0.24 under Swap (0.35 on real CTs), and classifiers trained on synthetic CTs obtain an AUROC of 0.54–0.69 when tested on real CTs, against 0.78 when the training set is real. RAGText2CT and Text2CT are the top two on Realism, Diversity and Report Agreement.
blocks.zh: 没有发生器在可信度上到达真正的 CT 。 表2显示五个基准发电机的总体业绩。 在其信用行中,FD是其真实CT值的15至40倍,覆盖范围最多为0.44(真实CT值为0.94),报告协议在交换(真实CT值为0.35)下只下降0.04-0.24,经过合成CT培训的分类人员在真实CT测试时获得0.54-0.69的AUROC,而实际培训时为0.78. RAGText2CT和Text2CT是现实主义,多样性和报告协议的前两名.

blocks.en: Credibility and Control dissociate. RAGText2CT and Text2CT have the lowest Effusion Add: when the effusion sentence is added, the proportion of CTs with an effusion rises from 7% to 12% and from 7% to 9%, compared with 5% to 62% for MedSyn, fourth on Realism. RAGText2CT and Text2CT, instead, remove an effusion more often than they add one (Effusion Remove + 0.18 +0.18 and + 0.21 +0.21 ); GenerateCT does the opposite (Effusion Add + 0.20 +0.20 , Effusion Remove + 0.09 +0.09 ).
blocks.zh: 可信度和控制断层。 RAGText2CT和Text2CT的Efunation Add:在加入Efunation句子时,有Efunation的CT的比例从7%上升至12%,从7%上升至9%,而MedSyn为5%-62%,在Realism上为第四. 反之,RAGText2CT和Text2CT更经常地去除一次除液(Efunation Remove + 0.18+0.18和+ 0.21+0.21);生成CT则相反(Efunation Add + 0.20+0.20,Efunation Remove + 0.09).

blocks.en: Control depends on the finding. In the C1 rows of Tab. 2 , Text2CT, last on Effusion Add ( + 0.02 +0.02 ), is among the most responsive generators on the heart (Heart Enlarge + 0.16 +0.16 , Heart Normalise + 0.21 +0.21 ). MedSyn2, second on both effusion measures, is fourth on both heart measures ( + 0.07 +0.07 , + 0.06 +0.06 ), while the mean volume of the hearts generated by GenerateCT does not change detectably with either edit ( − 0.02 -0.02 , + 0.00 +0.00 ). Control therefore depends on the edited finding: a ranking obtained by editing one finding does not carry over to another. None reaches the ideal or real value on C1: at best, Effusion Add is + 0.57 +0.57 (ideal 1) and a heart edit 57% of the value on real CTs ( + 0.21 +0.21 vs. + 0.37 +0.37 ).

blocks.en: No generator is best on every Control measure. MedSyn, best on Effusion Add, is worst on Negated Findings (0.09 [0.07, 0.11]). MedSyn2 is best on Distant Anatomy ( θ + = 0.005 \theta_{+}=0.005 ) but fourth on Seed Agreement ( κ + = 0.36 \kappa_{+}=0.36 ): whether an added effusion appears often depends on the seed. Again, Realism and Control dissociate: CTFlow has the lowest FD (0.31), but ranks third of six on Effusion Add ( + 0.24 +0.24 ; + 0.44 +0.44 on the edits it reads: 52 of 100 fall beyond its 128-token window), and the report explains 13% of its feature variance over cases and seeds (13–64% for the five generators; App. A). The Pre-Flight Checks flag Edits not read : the 52 edits beyond its window give the same CT as the unedited report. The Report Card adds Low diversity (coverage 0.25) and, as borderline, Seed-driven , since a new seed changes the CT as much as Off-topic text, and Rewrites the chest when editing , since the distant anatomy changes almost as much as for another patient (App. D).

blocks.en: 5.1 Comparison with Published Metrics
blocks.zh: 5.1 与公布的计量比较

blocks.en: Published metrics do not capture the discrepancies revealed by CtrlCT. Figure 6 a–d shows, on the same CTs, four published metrics against the corresponding measures computed by the toolkit: FD, the AUROC of a findings classifier, a population measure repeated over seeds and paired SSIM [ 25 , 24 ] .
blocks.zh: 公布的度量衡没有记录到CtrlCT所揭示的差异. 图6 a-d显示,在同一CTs上,对照工具包计算的相应措施,公布了四个指标:FD、一个结果分类器的AUROC、一个重复在种子上进行的人口计量以及组合的SSIM[25、24]。

blocks.en: FD misses report dependence ( Fig. 6 a). Replacing the report with Off-topic text changes the FD by less than 3% for RAGText2CT, Text2CT and MedSyn2. Report Use, which compares each CT with the one generated from Off-topic text for the same case and seed, separates them: the CTs of the first two change almost as much as with another case’s report (0.94 and 0.93), those of MedSyn2 much less (0.38). FD can compare populations as a whole, but gives no information on their content, which can vary widely for the same FD.
blocks.zh: FD 缺少报告依赖性(图6a)。 用非专题文本替换报告,对RAGText2CT、Text2CT和MedSyn2的FD修改不到3%。 将每个CT与从非专题文本中生成的同一案例和种子进行比较的报告使用将两者分开:前两个案例的CT与另一个案例的报告(0.94和0.93)的CT几乎相同。 FD可以比较整个人口,但不会给出有关其内容的信息,对于相同的FD来说,这种信息可以有很大的差异.

blocks.en: Findings AUROC misses the response to an edit ( Fig. 6 b). On the source CTs, a classifier’s effusion AUROC against the report labels rates Text2CT and MedSyn alike (0.90, 0.89): both draw an effusion for the patients whose reports describe one. But those reports differ in many other findings. When only the effusion sentence is added, at the same seed, an effusion appears with MedSyn and hardly ever with Text2CT (Effusion Add + 0.57 +0.57 and + 0.02 +0.02 ). The published metric does not register this even on the edited reports: scored against them, the macro AUROC over the 18 findings differs by less than 0.005 between the edited CTs and the original ones, which ignore the edit; only the AUROC of the edited finding differs: 0.70 for MedSyn and 0.18 for Text2CT, below chance because most of its edited CTs keep the effusion state of the original report.
blocks.zh: 调查结果 AUROC 错过了对编辑的回应(图6b)。 在来源CTs上,一个分类者的AUROC与报告标出Text2CT和MedSyn的分数(0.90,0.89):两者都为报告描述的病人画一个分数。 但是,这些报告在其他许多调查结果中有所不同。 当只添加精液的句子时,在同一种种子中,会出现与MedSyn的精液,很少出现与Text2CT的精液(精液添加+0.57+0.57和+0.02+0.02). 所公布的衡量标准甚至没有在编辑的报告上予以记录:对照它们得分,经编辑的CT和原始的CT之间的宏观AUROC差不到0.005,忽略了编辑;只有经编辑的AUROC不同:MedSyn为0.70,Text2CT为0.18,低于机会,因为大多数经编辑的CT保持了原始报告的输液状态.

blocks.en: Paired SSIM misses systematic shifts ( Fig. 6 c). SSIM beyond 50 mm from the effusion compares the CTs before and after the edit at the same seed. It rates Text2CT close to RAGText2CT and GenerateCT (0.45, 0.39, 0.30): in all three the distant anatomy changes. But a low SSIM does not tell whether the edit moves this anatomy the same way at every seed, a systematic shift, or only changes it as much as a new seed would. Distant Anatomy can: θ + \theta_{+} is 0.076 for Text2CT, whose shift stays within the variation across seeds, and 1.79 and 2.87 for RAGText2CT and GenerateCT, whose shift exceeds it.

blocks.en: Rates over seeds miss seed-decided cases ( Fig. 6 d). Repeated over the three seeds, the proportion of successful additions has a standard deviation of at most 0.011: as a population, every generator is stable. Single additions are not. With MedSyn, 22% of eligible additions succeed at some seeds and fail at others, and with MedSyn2 48%, while Text2CT and RAGText2CT are consistent only in failing (91% of their eligible additions fail at every seed). Seed Agreement separates MedSyn from MedSyn2 ( κ + \kappa_{+} 0.70 and 0.36).

blocks.en: Insights
blocks.zh: 透视

blocks.en: One sentence does not control one finding. Whether a finding appears depends on the other findings of the report, not only on its own sentence. When the edit fails, the rest of the report decides: among the removals, which all use the sentence “No pleural effusion was detected.”, an effusion remains in 45% of Text2CT’s CTs when the other findings make one unlikely (lowest third) and in 74% when they make one likely (highest third; App. C). When the edit succeeds, other findings change with it: for MedSyn and MedSyn2, 14 and 13 of the 17 other findings shift after an added effusion as they co-occur with effusion in real reports (Spearman 0.71 and 0.44; Fig. 6 e), including findings that the report negates. Both results are consistent with generators that learn associations between whole reports and whole CTs.
blocks.zh: 一句话不能控制一个发现。 调查结果是否出现取决于报告的其他调查结果,而不仅仅取决于它自己的句子。 当编辑失败时,报告的其他部分决定:在全部使用“没有检测到胸膜充血。 ”句子的清除中,45 %的Text2CT的CT(其他结果导致一个不太可能(最低第3位))和74%的Efusion(最高第3位;App.C)。 当编辑成功时,其他发现随它而变化:对于MedSyn和MedSyn2,其他17个发现中的14个和13个,由于在真实报告(Spearman 0.71和0.44;图6 e)中与充电共同传播而增加了充电量,包括报告否定的结论。 这两个结果都与学习整个报告和整个CT之间关联的生成器一致.

blocks.en: Text content weakly controls the CT. With the report replaced by Off-topic text, the CTs of GenerateCT, RAGText2CT and Text2CT change about as much as with another case’s report (Report Use 1.02, 0.94 and 0.93), and still by 1.08, 0.65 and 0.52 when its words are only permuted (Scramble); these three have the lowest Effusion Add ( + 0.20 +0.20 , + 0.05 +0.05 and + 0.02 +0.02 ). MedSyn and MedSyn2 change less (0.68 and 0.38) and have the highest Effusion Add ( + 0.57 +0.57 and + 0.47 +0.47 ). A strong response to the text is therefore no sign of Control: text describing no chest changes their CTs only as much as another case’s report. The change stays limited even for a heavily corrupted text, which lets us state that their knowledge is weakly controlled by the text content.
blocks.zh: 文本内容控制薄弱 CT. 由于报告被非专题文本所取代,生成语的CTs、RAGText2CT和Text2CT的改变与另一个案例的报告(使用1.02、0.94和0.93的报告)一样多,当其单词只被渗透(Scramble ) 时仍会变化1.08、0.65和0.52;这三种语言的Efunation Add(+ 0.20+0.20、+ 0.05+0.05和+ 0.02 ) 。 MedSyn和MedSyn2的改变较少(0.68和0.38),而且其Efunation Add(+ 0.57+0.57+0.47 ) 。 因此,对文本的强烈反应不是Control的标志:文本只描述其CT的任何改变,而是另一个案例的报告。 即使对严重腐败的文本来说,这种改变仍然有限,这让我们指出,他们的知识受到文本内容的薄弱控制。

blocks.en: Implications for evaluation. Realism, Report Agreement and Utility can be high even while an edit fails. At the current state of the art, a CT generated from an edited report cannot be assumed to match its label. Edits should be granularly evaluated: per finding, at the same seed and across seeds, against the findings that the report negates, and with the text window reported.
blocks.zh: 对评价的影响。 现实主义、报告协议和效用即使编辑失败也可能很高。 在目前的技术水平下,无法假定编辑报告生成的CT与其标签相符。 应当对编辑进行颗粒性评价:根据报告否定的结论,在同一个种子和不同种子之间,逐项发现,并报告文字窗口。

blocks.en: Limitations, Outlook and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 限制、展望和结论

blocks.en: Limitations. Our evaluators are automatic: no radiologist read the synthetic CTs. The study is vertical on chest CT, with one dataset and no other anatomy or modality. We edit two findings, among those that both evaluators detect reliably. Edits use three seeds, and the rules are calibrated on five generators and tested on one held-out generator.
blocks.zh: 限制。 我们的评估员是自动的:没有放射学家读过合成的CT. 该研究垂直于胸部CT,有一个数据集,没有其他解剖学或模式. 我们编辑了两个结果,其中两个评估者都可靠地检测到。 编辑部使用3种种子,规则在5台发电机上校准,在1台被搁置的发电机上测试.

blocks.en: Future directions and conclusion. We presented CtrlCT, a unified framework for the fair evaluation of Text-to-CT generators, and found serious gaps in current evaluations: the most credible generators are not the most controllable, and published metrics miss it. Next steps are other domains and, above all, generators that account for all these dimensions, to be used with more confidence and control and to advance the field.
blocks.zh: 未来方向与结论. 我们提出了CtrlCT,这是公平评价Text对CT生成器的统一框架,并发现当前评价中存在严重漏洞:最可靠的生成器不是最可控制的,公布的衡量标准也错过了它. 下一步是其它领域,首先是涉及所有这些层面的发电机,以便更加自信和控制地使用,并推进实地工作。

blocks.en: C.2 The Ideal Value of Report Use
blocks.zh: C.2 报告使用的理想价值

blocks.en:
Report Use compares the CTs generated at the same seed from a report and from its perturbation (Eq. (1)): it measures how much the CT moves with the text, not whether the CT follows its meaning, and it fails at both ends. At r = 0 r=0 the CT does not move: the perturbation is ignored. At r ≥ 1 r\geq 1 the perturbation moves the CT as far as changing the case does, although the seed is shared; on real CTs, among the known changes only slice shuffling, which destroys
the 3D anatomy, reaches this distance (1.03, Sec. A.4 ). No reference fixes a correct value in
between: a real CT does not change with its report, and the task does not say how far a CT should move. We therefore take as ideal, by convention, the value farthest from both failures, r = 0.5 r=0.5 , and score Report Use as s = 1 − 2 ​ | min ⁡ ( r , 1 ) − 0.5 | , s=1-2\,\bigl|\min(r,1)-0.5\bigr|, (A9) which is 0 at both failures and 1 at r = 0.5 r=0.5 . The Report Card places s s between its centre (0) and rim (1).

Their results are reported at the top of the Report Card, where each check is marked as passed (✓) or flagged
( ! ). When a check is flagged, the card also indicates the evaluation measures that may be compromised.

blocks.en:
• Complete. This check verifies that every text–seed pair of the Prompt Suite has a generated CT. If it
is flagged, the whole process is interrupted and the evaluation does not start. • Spacing. A generator produces its volumes on the voxel grid it was trained on, but the spacing in
the header of a saved CT is only the one its saving code writes. When the code does not write it explicitly,
SimpleITK and nibabel set a default of 1 × \times 1 × \times 1 mm, which may differ from the spacing the generator
actually uses: MedSyn2, trained at 0.7 mm, and MedSyn save their CTs this way ( Tab. A14 ). This check
assesses this consistency: it is flagged when every CT has a spacing of 1 × \times 1 × \times 1 mm, or when the median
lung width (left–right extent of the lungs, in mm) falls outside the range of real CTs (234–321 mm,
2.5th–97.5th percentiles). The toolkit resamples every CT to the grid of each evaluator from the spacing in the header, so a flagged spacing must be corrected in the header before measuring, as done here for MedSyn and MedSyn2. • HU. This check tests whether the intensities of the generated CTs are calibrated consistently with
real CTs. It flags an intensity landmark (air outside the body; lung, fat and soft-tissue histogram peaks) whose median
differs from that of the 940 real CTs by more than max ⁡ ( IQR , 25 ​ HU ) \max(\mathrm{IQR},25\,\mathrm{HU}) , with IQR its interquartile
range across real CTs (air 8, lung 75, fat 15, soft tissue 10 HU). Any floor between 15 and 35 HU flags the same
generators, so the outcome does not depend on this choice. If it is flagged, the evaluation proceeds and the toolkit does not rescale the intensities. • Pose. This check compares the orientation declared in the header of the generated CTs (axis codes, e.g . LPS, RAS) with the actual orientation of the anatomy in the volume ( Fig. A8 ). The anatomical orientation
is assessed in 10 generated CTs segmented by
TotalSegmentator [ 46 ] : the heart gives the left–right direction, the spine the
antero-posterior one, and the lungs above the liver the cranio-caudal one. This assumes the heart on the left, true
except in situs inversus (about 1 in 10,000 people [ 7 ] ). On real CTs, the assessment
returns LPS, the DICOM patient convention. The reports confirm it independently: one-sided effusions effectively lie on the side
the report states. The check has three outcomes ( Fig. A8 c): – If the 10 CTs disagree on the direction of an axis, the check is flagged. The evaluation then uses the
direction found in at least 8 of the 10 CTs, and stops if no direction reaches this majority. – If the header declares an orientation different from the assessed one, the check is flagged and the toolkit
handles it: the evaluators that read the header (TotalSegmentator, NV-Reason-CT) receive the CTs with the assessed
orientation written in the header. This happens when the saving code writes a fixed orientation that does not
follow the array. – If the header agrees with the assessed orientation, the check is not flagged, even when the orientation is
not LPS, since this is only a convention of the generator. In every case, the evaluators that read only the voxels (FD, Pillar-0) receive the CTs reoriented to LPS. • Seed. This check detects a generator that ignores the seed, i.e . one whose CTs at two seeds are
identical for at least one report (each edit case is generated at three seeds). If it is flagged, Seed Agreement
holds by construction, and Distant Anatomy, which compares the change due to the edit with the variation across
seeds, cannot be computed. • Text Window. This check determines whether the edited sentence of each report falls within the text
window of the generator, i.e . the number of tokens its text encoder reads. Since text encoders and their tokenizers
differ widely across generators, the check is carried out on the generated CTs: an edit is flagged when the CT of the
edited report is voxel-identical to the CT of the original report at the same seed. Flagged edits count as failures. In the five benchmarked generators, tokenizing the texts shows that these are
exactly the edits beyond the window of the text encoder.

Measures. The Report Card ( Figs. A9 and A10 ) shows every measure in two ways: as a
bar, in the Control and Credibility panels, and as a spoke of the profile at the top. Since the measures have
different units and ranges (FD and θ \theta have no upper bound, AUROC lies between 0.5 and 1, the C1 effects
between − 1 -1 and 1), the card maps each measure x x to a position u ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] u\in[0,1] , with u = 0 u=0 at its null control x 0 x_{0} and u = 1 u=1 at its real or ideal value x 1 x_{1} (grey columns of Tab. A9 ), clipped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . These two
anchors are fixed for each measure and are the same for every generator ( Tab. A15 ). Each bar runs from u = 0 u=0 to u = 1 u=1 and shows the position
of the generator with its 95% confidence interval, where the measure has one ( Sec. A.4 ), next to
the measured value; ticks on the bar mark the positions of the benchmarked generators, from the frozen reference
release. The profile is a radar chart with one spoke for each measure of Fig. 2, from u = 0 u=0 at the centre to u = 1 u=1 at the rim. The variants indented in Tab. 2 ( θ − \theta_{-} , r r under Scramble) appear as bars only. For Report
Agreement, the spoke shows the drop under Swap rather than the AUROC, because the drop isolates the part of the
agreement that is specific to the CT’s own report: it measures how much better a CT agrees with its own report than
with the report of another case, and is 0 when it agrees with any report as well as with its own.

Rules. Twelve diagnostic rules turn the measures into named failure modes, which the card lists with what to

blocks.en: D.5 Release
blocks.zh: D.5 释放

blocks.en:
CT-RATE (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) cannot be redistributed, in whole or in part, but data derived from it can be shared within
its privacy terms. An edited report is part of the dataset; synthetic CTs, features and readouts are derived data. We
therefore release the edits instead of the edited texts, with a script that rebuilds the texts from the user’s copy of
CT-RATE. We release all data under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with the access conditions of CT-RATE, which keeps the
non-commercial terms of MedSyn (CC BY-NC 4.0) and of the MedSyn2 weights, and the code under Apache 2.0 (datasheet in Tab. A19 ). The release contains 30,525 CTs, 6,105 per generator: the 6,017 of the Full suite ( Sec. D.3 ), the 80 rewordings ( Sec. C.8 ) and 8 CTs of the original reports, at the second and third seeds, of four of the five excluded effusion cases ( Tab. A2 ); those of the fifth, a heart case, are part of the Full suite.
